answer: Producing a novel, coherent answer each epoch is cheap per alias but prohibitive across thousands, so scale buys less credibility — the attacker cannot simply buy a large, credible flock. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a saffron as the anchor of the cost.
